items.title: 60 Days of System Design: A Comprehensive Study Guide
items.description: An exhaustive architectural study guide synthesizing 60 core system design topics across 7 architectural domains with 60 high-impact scenario breakdowns.

items.title: Advanced Consensus — Crash Fault Tolerance (CFT) vs. Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT)
items.description: Deep mathematical and architectural guide to distributed consensus, proving the 2f+1 vs 3f+1 quorum thresholds, PBFT three-phase commit, HotStuff linear pipelining, and Byzantine attack defenses.

items.title: Architecture Fundamentals
items.description: Core principles of distributed systems architecture including CAP theorem, consistency models, availability, partition tolerance, and key trade-offs every engineer must understand.

items.title: Blockchain Production Engineering - Reorgs, Nonces, Keys, Indexers
items.description: Production runbook for blockchain backends - deposit detection with reorg safety, nonce management, transaction replacement, idempotency, key custody with HSM/MPC, RPC resilience, gas estimation, observability, and incident response.

items.title: CAP Theorem & PACELC: A Senior Engineer's Deep Dive
items.description: Full-depth guide to CAP theorem and PACELC — the GitHub 2018 incident, why 'choose 2 of 3' is misleading, PACELC's EL trade-off (latency vs consistency during normal operation), database classification matrix, conflict resolution costs, and Brewer's 12-year correction.

items.title: CockroachDB Architecture: Multi-Raft, HLC & Distributed ACID
items.description: Masterclass guide to CockroachDB internals — 5-layer architecture (SQL, Transaction, Distribution, Replication, Storage), Hybrid Logical Clocks (HLC), Multi-Raft consensus, Leaseholders, Write Intents, Parallel Commits, Read Uncertainty, and Pebble storage engine.

items.title: Consensus Mechanisms - PoW, PoS, BFT, and Finality
items.description: Distributed consensus for blockchains - FLP impossibility, Nakamoto consensus, Proof of Stake with Casper FFG, PBFT/Tendermint, Raft vs BFT, fork choice, 51% attacks, long-range attacks, and trade-offs.

items.title: Consistent Hashing: An Advanced Architectural Guide
items.description: A comprehensive deep dive into consistent hashing, addressing modulo scaling bottlenecks, hash rings, virtual nodes, data replication, interview questions, and real-world implementations.

items.title: CRDTs & Collaborative Systems: Operational Transformation vs Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types
items.description: Deep dive into real-time collaborative architectures — State-based vs Operation-based CRDTs, the Join-Semilattice mathematical proof, Sequence CRDTs (RGA, Yjs, Automerge), Operational Transformation (OT in Google Docs), and tombstone garbage collection.

items.title: Database Re-Sharding: Zero-Downtime Migration Approaches & Trade-Offs
items.description: Senior Principal Engineer guide to database re-sharding, live cluster migration approaches, pros and cons, dual-write choreography, CDC replication, consistent hash expansion, and range splits.

items.title: Database Sharding & Partitioning
items.description: A complete guide to horizontal scaling — sharding strategies, consistent hashing, cross-shard complexities, rebalancing, distributed ID generation, and real-world database comparisons.

items.title: Distributed Systems
items.description: Core distributed systems concepts including consensus algorithms, leader election, vector clocks, distributed transactions, fault tolerance, and the fallacies of distributed computing.

items.title: Distributed Transactions: 2PC vs. Saga Pattern
items.description: Master guide to distributed transactions in microservices — Two-Phase Commit (2PC), Saga Pattern (Choreography vs. Orchestration), Transactional Outbox + CDC, and NewSQL architectures.

items.title: Kafka Broker — Complete Guide
items.description: A complete guide to Kafka brokers — what they are, how storage works, partition leadership, replication, ISR, KRaft vs ZooKeeper, log compaction, performance internals, and production monitoring. Beginner through senior depth.

items.title: Kafka Exactly-Once Semantics (EOS)
items.description: A complete guide to Kafka exactly-once semantics — delivery guarantees, idempotent producer, transactions, read_committed consumers, Kafka Streams EOS, zombie producer fencing, two-phase commit internals, and production patterns.

items.title: Kafka Streams — Senior & Principal Interview Questions
items.description: 15 rigorous senior and principal staff engineer interview questions on Kafka Streams, covering Stream-Time traps, RocksDB cgroup OOMs, Cooperative Sticky Assignor, EOS V2 transaction internals, sub-topology reorder storms, and The Four Golden Rules.

items.title: KRaft vs ZooKeeper: Kafka Metadata Architecture
items.description: Comprehensive guide comparing Apache Kafka's legacy ZooKeeper architecture with the modern KRaft (Kafka Raft) metadata mode — covering internal mechanics, failure scenarios, Strimzi Kubernetes deployment, migration strategies, and production deep dives for senior engineers.

items.title: Payment Processing Resilience: Idempotency, Deduplication & Loss Prevention
items.description: Principal engineering guide to payment processing resilience — multi-tier deduplication, request fingerprinting, retriable error classification, the transactional outbox pattern, reverse inquiry polling, and 3-way reconciliation engines.

items.title: Preventing Kafka Connect Rebalance Storms
items.description: Deep-dive into Kafka Connect rebalance storm internals — why they happen, the two rebalance protocols, incremental cooperative mechanics, task assignment algorithms, Spring Boot monitoring, and a production-grade rolling restart runbook.

items.title: Raft Consensus Algorithm
items.description: A comprehensive guide to the Raft Consensus Algorithm — covering leader election, log replication, safety guarantees, and how it is implemented in Apache Kafka's KRaft metadata mode.

items.title: Redis Interview Questions & Answers
items.description: Senior-level Redis interview questions covering data structures, persistence, clustering, cache patterns, distributed systems, and production failure scenarios.

items.title: Saga Pattern (Distributed Workflows)
items.description: A comprehensive guide to the Saga Pattern — from core concepts for beginners to choreography vs orchestration internals, state machine design, idempotency, compensating transactions, temporal coupling, failure taxonomy, and production observability for senior engineers.

items.title: Scaling Writes
items.description: Deep-dive into high write throughput techniques — sharding, partitioning, WAL internals, LSM trees, async pipelines, batching, backpressure, idempotency, and distributed transactions — with production Java/Spring code and failure mode analysis.

items.title: Split-Brain: Dual Primary & Multi-Leader Divergence
items.description: Senior Principal deep dive into split-brain syndrome, dual-primary scenarios, multi-leader data divergence, fencing tokens, STONITH, and conflict reconciliation (LWW vs CRDTs vs Version Vectors).

items.title: Time, Ordering & Distributed Unique ID Generation
items.description: Deep dive into distributed time synchronisation, physical clock drift, TrueTime, Lamport timestamps, Vector Clocks, Hybrid Logical Clocks (HLC), and distributed ID schemes (UUIDv7 RFC 9562 vs Snowflake vs UUIDv4) with B-Tree storage implications.

items.title: Transactional Outbox Pattern
items.description: A complete guide to the Transactional Outbox Pattern — from the Dual-Write problem for beginners to CDC vs polling internals, at-least-once guarantees, ordering semantics, and production monitoring for senior engineers.

items.title: Two-Phase Commit (2PC) & Three-Phase Commit (3PC)
items.description: A comprehensive guide to Two-Phase Commit (2PC) and Three-Phase Commit (3PC) — from real-world analogies for beginners to WAL internals, failure modes, and XA implementation for senior engineers.
